rapport_notes: Genuine empathy ("I'm sorry, I'm sorry") for a sensitive personal situation, flexible and reassuring throughout.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: I'm going through a high-conflict divorce and I'm on the lease... I haven't told her yet -> rep: I'm sorry, I'm sorry... I have a solution for that (quick empathetic pivot straight to the logistics fix, no further follow-up on the situation itself).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Not reached -- correctly and cleanly deferred to a photo/video walkthrough alternative since a live FaceTime tour wasn't feasible; next steps (link sent today, photos uploaded, quote to follow) were clearly confirmed.

top_strength: Handled an unusually sensitive personal situation (divorce, moving without the ex-spouse's knowledge) with genuine empathy and offered a creative, flexible alternative (photo/video upload) when a live virtual walkthrough wasn't feasible.
coaching_note: After the customer disclosed the divorce situation, a brief personal follow-up (e.g. asking how he's holding up, or about his timeline concerns) would have gone deeper than the quick pivot straight to the logistics solution.
